Title: TFGTRS-4598 - PLP shows a product whose variant is out of stock in SFCC but still listed by Constructor - Phase Eight
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Access to Business Manager (inventory) on dev. A test product visible on a PLP. Its variant has no stock or no inventory list assigned in SFCC (isOrderable = false) while Constructor still lists it (index not updated yet).
Steps:
1. In Business Manager open Merchandising > Products, find the variant and, in the Availability tab, remove the stock or the inventory list assignment. Wait about a minute (ATS cache).
2. Check on the PDP that the variant is shown as out of stock.
3. Open the PLP of the category that contains the product on dev.phase-eight.com.
4. Look for the product.
Expected: The product is displayed in the PLP even though the variant is not orderable. Before the change it disappeared from the list.

Title: TFGTRS-4598 - PDP of the out-of-stock product is not broken
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Access to Business Manager (inventory) on dev. The product from the previous case.
Steps:
1. From the PLP open the product that has a non-orderable variant.
2. Select the out-of-stock size.
3. Try to add it to the bag.
Expected: The PDP loads correctly. The out-of-stock variant shows the out-of-stock / notify state and cannot be added to the bag.

Title: TFGTRS-4598 - Products that are offline, not searchable, dummy or grouped masters stay hidden
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Access to Business Manager (inventory) on dev.
Steps:
1. Take a product that is offline (or not searchable) in Business Manager but still returned by Constructor.
2. Open the PLP that should contain it.
Expected: The product is not displayed. The number of tiles can differ from the number of Constructor results for these reasons, but not because of stock.

Title: TFGTRS-4598 - Fully out-of-stock products blocked in Constructor are not displayed
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Product with zero stock synced to Constructor (after the inventory_count fix, TFGTRS-4484).
Steps:
1. Choose a product with zero stock in all variants and wait for the Constructor sync.
2. Open the PLP of its category.
Expected: The product is not listed because Constructor blocks zero stock items, with no SFCC stock lookup involved.

Title: TFGTRS-4598 - PLP loads, filters, sorting and loading more products work - Phase Eight
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available).
Steps:
1. Open a category PLP on dev.phase-eight.com.
2. Apply a filter and a sort order.
3. Scroll or use the pagination to load more products.
Expected: Products load, filters and sorting apply correctly and more products load without errors.
